notes.title: 99 Fails Lite is out now!
notes.notes:
Launching with a 10% discount, 99 Fails Lite is released for you to get a taste of Zeebo's surreal dreamworld! 

Dash across pillars as bizarre events unfold and freaky entities haunt you in your quest to reach the end!
